waveTitle: Five pieces, each looping against the reference
summary: Foundation set: navy/cream/brass identity, Newsreader + Libre Franklin, a reveal/masked-line/parallax motion engine, six pages. Five builder-critic pairs are now looping in parallel — each critic re-shoots the real render, compares it blind against the Oryzo captures, and sends the builder back whenever the reference wins. A separate agent is sourcing licence-clear photography.

log.m: Foundation: navy/cream/brass identity, Newsreader + Libre Franklin self-hosted, reveal/line-mask/parallax motion engine, six pages. Oryzo captured at 1440x900 and 390x844.
Launched five builder/critic loops (scroll, pilots, people, forum, chrome) plus a coherence pass, and a media agent sourcing CC-licensed photography.
